text.hi: किताब: ‘A night before the examination’ पर पैराग्राफ़ लिखो। शब्द: worry, confusion, books and notes scattered, cramming, last revision, no sleep, fear of examination। चलो छोटे-छोटे वाक्य बनाएँ।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: ‘A night before the examination’ par paragraph likho. Shabd: worry, confusion, books and notes scattered, cramming, last revision, no sleep, fear of examination. Chalo chhote-chhote vaakya banaayein.
text.en: The book: write a paragraph on ‘A night before the examination’ using: worry, confusion, books and notes scattered, cramming, last revision, no sleep, fear of examination. Let's build short sentences.

steps.meaning: learning a lot quickly just before a test
steps.example: Cramming at night is not a good habit.

exampleMeaning.hi: रात को रटना अच्छी आदत नहीं है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Raat ko ratna achhi aadat nahi hai.

steps.example: My notes were scattered on the bed.

exampleMeaning.hi: मेरे नोट्स बिस्तर पर बिखरे थे।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Mere notes bistar par bikhre the.

prompt.hi: परीक्षा से पहले की रात मैं बहुत चिंता में था।
prompt.hinglish: Pariksha se pehle ki raat main bahut chinta mein tha.
prompt.en: Tell how you felt the night before the exam.

steps.answer: I was very worried the night before the examination.

meaning.hi: परीक्षा से पहले की रात मैं बहुत चिंता में था।
meaning.hinglish: Pariksha se pehle ki raat main bahut chinta mein tha.

prompt.hi: मेरी किताबें और नोट्स चारों तरफ़ बिखरे थे।
prompt.hinglish: Meri kitaabein aur notes chaaron taraf bikhre the.
prompt.en: Tell where your study things were.

steps.answer: My books and notes were scattered everywhere.

meaning.hi: मेरी किताबें और नोट्स चारों तरफ़ बिखरे थे।
meaning.hinglish: Meri kitaabein aur notes chaaron taraf bikhre the.

prompt.en: Tell what you did with your lessons one final time.

prompt.hi: मैं पूरी रात सो नहीं पाया।
prompt.hinglish: Main poori raat so nahi paaya.
prompt.en: Tell about your sleep that night.

steps.answer: I could not sleep the whole night.

meaning.hi: मैं पूरी रात सो नहीं पाया।
meaning.hinglish: Main poori raat so nahi paaya.

prompt.hi: अब मैं रोज़ पढ़ूँगा ताकि डर न लगे।
prompt.hinglish: Ab main roz padhoonga taaki dar na lage.
prompt.en: Make a promise about studying every day.

steps.answer: Now I will study every day.
